design: 12 fixed prompt templates repeated ~83 times (1k run) and ~833 times (10k run); this is repeated-measures sampling, not 1,000/10,000 distinct tasks.
caveat: The earlier 0/10,000 result was not reproduced. Do not claim zero. The 10k run uses 12 prompt templates, not 10k distinct tasks. Raw 10k logs are not included in this release; prompts and results schema are included.
